unit_rules.name: Tunnel Assault
unit_rules.text: If this unit was set up on the battlefield this Activation using +Deep Strike+, it is eligible to Charge this Activation even if it Advanced, and you can re-roll Charge rolls made for it.

unit_rules.name: Subterranean Hunters
unit_rules.text: Enemy units cannot use Overwatch against this unit in a Battle Round in which it was set up using +Deep Strike+.
